scope: Compare provider-neutral retrieval routes over the same compiled financial object population before any reranker or Evidence Role adoption decision.

query_contract.benchmark_compatibility: The frozen 18 qrels remain source-level comparators only; their mixed legacy wording is not the product runtime contract.

evaluation_levels.source_record_target: A hit means at least one returned compiled object carries lineage to an accepted target source record. This proves document discovery, not correct evidence selection.
evaluation_levels.reviewed_object_target: Only exact or bounded same-source claim/context successors may be scored as object targets. Legacy whole-table labels are not silently projected onto individual metric rows.
evaluation_levels.six_case_pairwise: ORCL, ASML and ANET remain observed validation pairs and are forbidden from tuning. They do not become full-corpus retrieval proof until their objects are rebuilt in the current compiler.
evaluation_levels.evidence_authority: No ranking hit is Evidence and no table-row hit is NumericFact.

routes.query_instruction: Given a financial research question, retrieve source-bound passages or table rows that directly answer the requested evidence role while respecting company, period and relationship direction.

route_winner_requires: no wrong-company or future-period hard-filter breach
source-record target recall does not hide reviewed-object regression
business-role errors are inspected in plain language
observed validation does not show material reversal
latency, GPU memory and persistent cache stay within the declared budget
decision_rules.multi_vector_out_of_union: report candidate-generation miss; do not score it as a multi-vector model miss

known_boundary: This comparison can select a provisional retriever and shadow challenger. It cannot close S1, build the S2 fact mart, prove dynamic Agentic Research, or establish report quality.
